explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows hydrochlorothiazide shortage ongoing since 2023-01-19 with multiple manufacturers affected

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows hydrochlorothiazide has been in shortage since 2023-01-19, spanning 45 months as of 2026-10-21.
Aurobindo Pharma USA's quinapril/hydrochlorothiazide tablets remain current on the shortage list with discontinuation of manufacture cited as the reason.
Chartwell Molecular Holdings LLC's quinapril/hydrochlorothiazide tablets also remain current on the shortage list since 2023-01-19.
Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc. has hydrochlorothiazide capsules listed as to be discontinued with a business decision to discontinue manufacture noted.
Current inventory across three Corvale sites ranges from 19 to 27 days on hand.
The rule-based best option is to buy from Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and whose plant Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited had an NAI inspection on 2024-07-26.
Additional alternate manufacturers not on the shortage list include DirectRx (plant inspection NAI 2026-06-04) and Macleods Pharmaceuticals Limited (plant inspection VAI 2023-10-20).

memory.text: Decision on lidocaine: switch lidocaine 1% 30 mL vials to 5 mL vials in the ED to reduce waste during the shortage. Rationale: Single-dose waste was a third of use (demo history). Approved by Alex Morgan, PharmD.

Decision on carboplatin: restrict carboplatin to curative-intent regimens while on allocation; oncology reviews each palliative order. Rationale: Two suppliers on allocation and under 10 days on hand at Corvale General (demo history). Approved by Jordan Hale, PharmD.

Q-04e736.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-88c0a9.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('c8c79657-a09a-bdb6-e053-2995a90ab673') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-445739.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-5e0ec3.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-fa7fe4.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%tablet%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-6aabd6.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('1831143', '1450743', '3004956904', '3004021229', '3008897678', '3011690045', '3007517881', '3006363714', '3003999190') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-01a4df.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('1831143', '1450743', '3004956904', '3004021229', '3008897678', '3011690045', '3007517881', '3006363714', '3003999190') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-089f4a.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('1831143') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('northwind health')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-14c327.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('northwind health') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-4696e2.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('952157') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-344552.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('51655027226')

Q-886872.sql: SELECT s.item_key, s.description, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.ndc_match FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE p.ndc11 IS NULL AND lower(s.description) LIKE '%hydrochlorothiazide%'
